text.en:
Creation of an Export Development Fund. The Ministry of Trade and Industry is hereby authorized to
enter into contracts with the private sector, whether foreign or domestic, such as exporters and importers,
traders, export producers and manufacturers, of Philippine products, for the promotion of such products
abroad. Any commission, fee of other income arising from such contracts and other export activities of the
Ministry shall constitute an Export Development Fund, a revolving fund which shall be available for the
operational expenses related to special export promotional activities of the Ministry, including incentive
compensation plans for the members of the Foreign Trade Service Corps.

Reports. The Ministry of Trade and Industry shall submit to the Ministry of Budget a monthly report of
the income from the fund and a quarterly report of expenditures as may be required by the General
Appropriations Act.

Implementing rules and regulations. The Minister of Trade and Industry is authorized to issue all
necessary rules and regulations to implement the provisions of this Order.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
